India's Monsoon Season Ends With Significant Rainfall Deficit

India's monsoon season concluded with a rainfall deficit of 12.6%, making it the fourth-lowest rainfall recorded since 2001. Fifteen states and Union Territories experienced below-normal rainfall during the season. The deficit was reported as 13% by some outlets.
